notes.title: Without Within 3's release date confirmed!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7686208/860fbebc8e56b72ec3551248288dff6e9df3b0c7.jpg

Hi everyone ːvintysmileː! Hope life has been good so far in 2018. I am happy to announce Without Within 3's release date has been confirmed:

http://store.steampowered.com/app/676130/Without_Within_3/

The 4th of May, 2018. Hope to see you there and then! Please find out more on the official webpage:

http://wowi3.invertmouse.com

Here are some screenshots for your enjoyment:

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7686208/c3827bfa5c0751d2bd00f45d5444e2153d608d40.jpg

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7686208/e075ea30462d03d9395c2e1fa72b1730d5728d96.jpg

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7686208/41ed3b8eec70eebe25d3e4a1d481bbb3ace0be28.jpg

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7686208/648541fdf9d70e91ead44f16afe552d806a4dc9c.jpg

And oh, here is a heads up; most of my games will go on sale a week before WOWI3 comes out. If you want to get in on some discounts, please check out Steam on April 30th. Hopefully it will be a nice lead into WOWI3's release.

Thank you ːexceliaː!
